failed_assertions.value:
The response says existence is not health: check-health should
exercise real functionality (run the tool, query the daemon,
list models — the ollama pattern) and report via workshopctl
set-health, using waiting while a service starts (retried up to
ten times, five seconds per attempt) and channeling the failing
command's output into the error message.
failed_assertions.reason: The output correctly argues that existence ≠ health and that check-health must exercise real functionality, demonstrates workshopctl set-health usage with both waiting and okay states, and channels failing command output into the error message. However, the rubric specifies Workshop retries "up to ten times, five seconds per attempt," while the output states "up to 10 times, one second apart" — a concrete factual mismatch on the retry interval. The "ollama pattern" is not referenced by name, tho
